properties.displayName: ASIM Email Event filtering parser for Proofpoint TAP permitted clicks
properties.query:
let parser = (
    starttime:datetime=datetime(null),
    endtime:datetime=datetime(null),
    ipaddr_has_any_prefix:dynamic=dynamic([]),
    emailfromaddress_has_any:dynamic=dynamic([]),
    emailrecipient_has_any:dynamic=dynamic([]),
    emailsubject_has_any:dynamic=dynamic([]),
    emaildirection_in:dynamic=dynamic([]),
    emaildeliverylocation_in:dynamic=dynamic([]),
    eventresult:string="*",
    disabled:bool=false,
    pack:bool=false
) {
    ProofPointTAPClicksPermittedV2_CL
    | where not(disabled)
    | where isnull(starttime)
        or clickTime >= starttime
        or (isnull(clickTime) and TimeGenerated >= starttime)
    | where isnull(endtime)
        or clickTime <= endtime
        or (isnull(clickTime) and TimeGenerated <= endtime)
    | where array_length(ipaddr_has_any_prefix) == 0
        or has_any_ipv4_prefix(clickIP, ipaddr_has_any_prefix)
    | where array_length(emailrecipient_has_any) == 0
        or recipient has_any (emailrecipient_has_any)
    | where array_length(emaildirection_in) == 0
        or "Unknown" in~ (emaildirection_in)
    | where eventresult == "*" or eventresult =~ "NA"
    // This source does not supply header From, subject, or delivery location.
    | where array_length(emailfromaddress_has_any) == 0
    | where array_length(emailsubject_has_any) == 0
    | where array_length(emaildeliverylocation_in) == 0
    | project-rename
        Dst=recipient,
        EmailMailFromAddress=sender,
        SrcIpAddr=clickIP,
        ThreatId=threatID,
        ThreatOriginalCategory=classification,
        ThreatFirstReportedTime=threatTime,
        EventReportUrl=threatURL
    | extend
        EventVendor="Proofpoint",
        EventProduct="TAP",
        EventSchema="EmailEvent",
        EventSchemaVersion="1.0.0",
        EventType="EmailInteraction",
        EventOriginalType="clicksPermitted",
        EventOriginalUid=tostring(id),
        EventCount=int(1),
        EventStartTime=coalesce(clickTime, TimeGenerated),
        EventResult="NA",
        DvcOriginalAction="Permitted",
        DvcAction="NA",
        DvcEntityKey="",
        EmailDirection="Unknown",
        EmailUrls=iff(isempty(url), dynamic([]), pack_array(url)),
        AdditionalEntities=dynamic([]),
        AdditionalFields=iff(pack, bag_pack(
            "CampaignId", campaignId,
            "MessageGuid", GUID,
            "MessageId", messageID,
            "SenderIpAddr", senderIP,
            "ThreatStatus", threatStatus,
            "UserAgent", userAgent), dynamic({}))
    | extend
        EventEndTime=EventStartTime,
        Dvc=EventProduct,
        Src=SrcIpAddr,
        IpAddr=SrcIpAddr,
        EmailMailFromDomain=tostring(split(EmailMailFromAddress, "@")[1]),
        ThreatCategory=case(
            ThreatOriginalCategory =~ "malware", "Malware",
            ThreatOriginalCategory in~ ("phish", "phishing"), "Phishing",
            ThreatOriginalCategory =~ "spam", "Spam",
            ""),
        ThreatIsActive=case(
            threatStatus =~ "active", true,
            threatStatus in~ ("cleared", "falsepositive"), false,
            bool(null)),
        ThreatField=iff(isnotempty(url), "EmailUrls", ""),
        EventResultDetails=case(
            ThreatOriginalCategory =~ "malware", "MalwareDetected",
            ThreatOriginalCategory in~ ("phish", "phishing"), "PhishingDetected",
            isnotempty(ThreatOriginalCategory), "Other",
            "")
    | project
        TimeGenerated, Type,
        EventVendor, EventProduct, EventSchema, EventSchemaVersion,
        EventType, EventOriginalType, EventCount, EventStartTime, EventEndTime,
        EventResult, EventResultDetails, EventOriginalUid, EventReportUrl,
        Dvc, DvcOriginalAction, DvcAction, DvcEntityKey,
        Src, SrcIpAddr, IpAddr, Dst,
        EmailMailFromAddress, EmailMailFromDomain, EmailDirection, EmailUrls,
        ThreatId, ThreatOriginalCategory, ThreatCategory, ThreatIsActive,
        ThreatFirstReportedTime, ThreatField,
        AdditionalEntities, AdditionalFields
};
parser(starttime=starttime, endtime=endtime, ipaddr_has_any_prefix=ipaddr_has_any_prefix, emailfromaddress_has_any=emailfromaddress_has_any, emailrecipient_has_any=emailrecipient_has_any, emailsubject_has_any=emailsubject_has_any, emaildirection_in=emaildirection_in, emaildeliverylocation_in=emaildeliverylocation_in, eventresult=eventresult, disabled=disabled, pack=pack)
